description:
Jihun Han, or maybe the being called Adam.  
The being with the earliest memories of mankind, that repeats birth and death.  
Adam has existed in the scenes of various historical events.  
Now, the being does not want to repeat its life cycle of birth and death.  
He has planned for the end of the world to put an end to the eternal cycle of life.  
He has planned to execute the plan in this particular life as Jihun Han.   
(From  KENAZ's website)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=5290983), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000074516)
